analyzers.task: Human-visible occlusion/overlap on actual rendered source-backed designs
analyzers.method: Original author-authored normalized object geometry pairwise rectangle intersection >=10pct smaller box; no screenshot model, no semantic overlay intent
analyzers.model_version: SlideAudit UIST 2025 original object descriptions pinned 642d490b7c1d2e78a50a631bfd359433397f3ecf / Python stdlib
analyzers.scope: 343 original source-layout descriptions plus 105 human strong occlusion positives + 105 same-origin/alteration negative controls, 104 positive human region boxes, some slides intentionally altered

Source vs pixel combined OR finds 96/105 but increases false control alerts to40/105. Transferring to actual GUI apps requires independent original GUI benchmarks, not slides.

analyzers.task: Human-visible text cut-off vs original source object boundaries
analyzers.method: Original source TEXT_BOX rectangle outside slide by more than2pct of its own area, compared to previous actual pixel OCR border/canvas rule on same real slides
analyzers.model_version: SlideAudit source original geometry, 343 real/synthetic slides, Python stdlib numeric checks
analyzers.scope: 82 strong human overflow/cutoff positives and 82 matched strong negatives across original slides

analyzers.task: True source-mesh contact-chain analysis in original owner warehouse pallet/rack mechanical assembly
analyzers.method: Blender 4.0.2 CPU-only world-triangle vertical ray casts for named wood-steel contact and steel-to-original-rack at both endpoints, plus exact saved scene component identity and world geometry fingerprints
analyzers.model_version: Blender 4.0.2; three original saved stages v30 pre, v44 partial, v47 corrected, no learned inference
analyzers.scope: 24 real pallet meshes,72 steel supports,12 racks, two correlated repair stages with original source unchanged wood+supports, 5 movie frame checkpoints
analyzers.result: Intermediate 72 of 72 wood-steel within2mm but 0 of72 bearing racks both ends, corrected 72 of72 wood-steel and 72 of72 steel racks both ends. Wood meshes24/24 and support bounds72/72 identical between partial and corrected;12 racks rotated ninety degrees. 108 geometry instances stable 5 frames. Earlier one-dimensional stage gate was unsafe.
analyzers.limitations: One correlated product history not statistical IID cases; geometric triangle hits are neither proof of mechanical stress/load rating nor photographically plausible renders; erroneous/sparse probe negatives are not universal noncontact; known object roles and intended support path are required.

analyzers.model_version: Python scikit-learn logistic regression C1, original HuggingFace all 1500 file listing pinned dataset revision, no GPU/video inputs

analyzers.limitations: Videos never downloaded/decoded in metadata experiment; frame-only VLM inputs do not literally receive file bytes; cannot directly compare 320 metadata holdout to author 1500 VLM table as a paired model challenge; no unseen game engine or human subjective error labels.
